data.gender_notes: Fadlilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fadlilah is an Arabic name that means 'virtue of God' or 'God's bounty'. It is a name that signifies the blessings and favors of Allah. The name Fadlilah carries the meaning “Virtue of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadlilah usually hope their child will grow to embody virtue of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fadlilah is associated with the concept of Tawhid, or the oneness of God.
data.etymology: Fadlilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Virtue of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadlilah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
